title.narrative: Strengthening youth economic, social conditions & political rights awareness in CIV via digital

description.narrative: The goal of the project is to enhance the digital capacity of the youth in the Greater Abidjan and Grand Bassam district of Cote d’Ivoire. It will look at improving economic development, social living conditions and political awareness by encouraging youth entrepreneurship, digital capabilities through ICT. It will create an ecosystem that can serve as a basis for the development of the local digital economy. The project aims at directly benefiting 152 100 direct beneficiaries representing 220 digital entrepreneurs, 150 700 students, 180 young drop out of school, 1000 young people promoting peace and good governance. The project would benefit 886 900 indirect beneficiariesThe project will - promote digital entrepreneurship and increase students and dropped school youth digital skills for better market access.-accelerate access to digital by TVET promotion, digital software certification and women digital capacities building.- increase young people participation to political life through digital sensitization.

title.narrative: The project aimed to enhance youth digital access and foster green entrepreneurship. It utilized various means such as establishing digital infrastructure, providing basic and advanced ICT skills programs, along with green practices programs. Additionally, it organized the Greenpreneurs incubation program, created an enabling environment for green entrepreneurship, and built the capacity of Ivorian government and institutions in the digital green ecosystem.
